description: Two equal-length materials in series under a small displacement-controlled extension. The left half uses corotated elasticity and the right half stable Neo-Hookean elasticity. In the small-strain regime, axial traction is continuous and each region's strain is sigma/E. This scene quantitatively tests per-particle constitutive dispatch and shared-grid coupling across a material interface.

provenance.reference_formula: For two equal-area bars in series, sigma = Delta/(L1/E1 + L2/E2), epsilon_i = sigma/E_i, and traction is continuous at the interface.
regime_assumptions: small strain (approximately one percent total extension)
provenance.notes: Regional axial strain is estimated by linear regression over the central half of each material region, excluding equal quarter-region bands next to the clamps and interface. Interface traction is inferred as E_i times the measured small strain in each region.
